title: 'Haiwaan' BO Day 2 [LIVE]: Akshay Kumar, Saif Ali Khan eyes Rs 5 crore India net milestone
description: 'Haiwaan', the Priyadarshan-directed crime thriller starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, has opened to a modest response at the box office, entering Day 2 with its overall net collection still under Rs. 4 crore. The film, a remake of Priyadarshan's own Malayalam hit 'Oppam', now faces the challenge of building momentum through its first weekend as it competes for screen space and audience attention against other major releases currently running in theatres.

title: Kabir 9/11 reflections: Filmmaker recalls post-attack New York
description: Kabir Khan recalled being in the US during 9/11 and witnessing New York's grief, an experience that shaped his 2009 film 'New York'. Sharing skyline photos on Instagram, he described returning seven years later to shoot the film, exploring post-9/11 Islamophobia and identity. Celebrities like Shenaz Treasury shared similar memories in response.

title: 'Poonam ji tried to snatch phone': Kunickaa Sadanand on CINTAA crisis
description: Deeply troubled by the unrest within CINTAA, actress Kunickaa Sadanand has raised her concerns. Allegations surfaced that critical documents were extracted from the organization during a legal fracas. Authorities indicated needing the Charity Commissioner’s order for intervention, while FWICE members intervened, stopping a vehicle believed to be carrying the disputed papers, underscoring the pressing constitutional and electoral issues confronting the body.

title: Aamir Khan in talks for a SUPERHERO film with R Balki
description: The Bollywood film industry is gearing up to dive into the realm of superheroes, attracting attention from top stars. Aamir Khan has reportedly begun talks for a superhero project, which may bring him together with renowned director R Balki and producer Sajid Nadiadwala. Currently, the film remains in its nascent stages, with a script yet to be finalized and no official announcements from the parties involved.

title: Who is Suhas? Meet the Telugu actor winning praise for his role in 'Mandaadi'
description: Suhas Pagolu has garnered significant acclaim from Tamil film enthusiasts for his role in 'Mandaadi'. His bold step into a darker character has left audiences astounded, marking a noteworthy debut in Tamil cinema. Originally known for crafting digital content, Suhas has successfully transitioned to lead roles. Additionally, 'Mandaadi' has seen a robust start at the box office, affirming his impact in the industry.

title: Kunal Kemmu's 'VIBE' gets CBFC nod with 'A' certificate
description: Kunal Kemmu's upcoming film VIBE has officially received an adults-only certification from the CBFC, indicating its mature themes. The film, which runs for two hours and twenty-five minutes, stars Kemmu alongside Preity G Zinta and other talented actors. VIBE is set to hit theaters on September 18, 2026, promising an amusing cinematic experience for adult audiences.

title: Soori, Suhas and Mahima Nambiar's ‘Mandaadi’ OTT release details
description: Soori's latest Tamil action sports film 'Mandaadi' is making waves at the box office, delighting audiences with its gripping performances and storytelling. Currently enjoying a successful theatrical run, the film has caught Netflix's eye, securing its streaming rights for future release. While fans eagerly await the announcement of its OTT premiere date, it promises to keep viewers entertained long after its cinema run ends.

title: ‘Toxic’ actor defends Yash starrer: 'You have your own mind?'
description: In a show of support, actor Benedict Garrett champions Geetu Mohandas' film 'Toxic', urging audiences to develop their unique perspectives despite negative feedback. He describes the film as a mature fairy tale that delves into profound and dark themes. He highlights the remarkable performance by Yash and lauds the director's fearless approach in bringing this unconventional narrative to life.

title: Did Sivakarthikeyan indirectly mock Suriya while praising Soori’s ‘Mandaadi’?
description: Sivakarthikeyan's recent social media activity concerning two films premiering on the same day has ignited lively discussions among fans. His heartfelt post regarding Soori's 'Mandaadi' included an intriguing statement about how quality content prevails. This provoked speculation among followers about possible veiled references to box office competitions and historical rivalries.

title: Why ‘Hanuman Ansh’ won’t be India’s official Oscar entry this year
description: Hanuman Ansh is venturing into new territories by dubbing its film in Telugu, with the renowned filmmaker Trivikram Srinivas on board. In addition, the creators are introducing a video game and a comic book to complement the film. However, the team faced hurdles for overseas distribution and unfortunately missed the Oscar submission deadline amid various projects. Looking ahead, they are considering a sequel and further development of the film's universe.

title: Vishnu Vishal sends strong message to fans over fallout with actor Soori
description: Vishnu Vishal has urged his fans to refrain from discussing his past disagreement with actor Soori, emphasizing that their differences have been amicably resolved since 2024. The confusion leading to their fallout in 2020, which stemmed from a land deal, was reportedly instigated by a third party. Their public reconciliation in 2024 marks a new chapter in their relationship.

title: Bajpayee on Veer-Zaara set: Actor recalls brief role with Yash Chopra
description: Manoj Bajpayee recalled his cherished memories from 'Veer-Zaara' during promotions for 'Last Man in Tower'. He shared fond stories of working with Yash Chopra in Amritsar and Film City, praising his honesty and warmth. Bajpayee also revealed he hadn't realised how iconic his small role — of imprisoning SRK's character — would become.

The 114-year-old film company announced the milestone on Saturday, when the Matt Damon-led epic’s weekend haul will bring its domestic earnings to $601.2 million, with an international tally of $1.083 […]

description: Filmax is launching Mar Olid’s romantic comedy “The Wedding Hustlers” (“Si te he visto no me acuerdo”) internationally with a first promo for buyers at TIFF, ahead of its Spanish theatrical release in 2027. title: Barbara Kopple Returns to the Picket Line
description: Fifty years after 'Harlan County, U.S.A.,' the Oscar winner's 'Union Town' follows Amazon, UPS and delivery app workers organizing in her own hometown — and finds hope even in their setbacks.

description: A veteran of 'Vogue’ and other glossies, the filmmaker talks about the joys and tumults of publishing and how the pre-iPhone era is appealing to Zoomer watchers.

title: ‘Back to Buenos Aires’ Review: A Brooding Drama Revisits the Violent Days of Argentina’s Dictatorship, and the Traumas That Remained in Its Wake
description: Director Marco Bechis drew from his experience as a survivor of the 1976 military coup for this story of a political prisoner who returns to the place of his torment 30 years later.

title: Ben Silverman, Micah Green Back New Platform for Jewish Filmmakers
description: SHOOQ launches to connect Jewish storytellers with investors and philanthropists, aiming to pool resources rather than compete for scarce funding.

description: Cody Lightning’s feature film is all business on the ice — an underdog dramedy about a struggling Indigenous team fighting racism outside the rink.
